effect_description_eng: [On Play] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 card with [Millenniummon] in its name and 1 card with the [Composite] or [Wicked God] trait among them to the hand. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck.
inherited_effect_description_eng: ＜Retaliation＞ (When this Digimon is deleted after losing a battle, delete the Digimon it was battling.)
